name: Deep Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10327286 catalog plotted on satellite 39.7725,-107.2965: site 22 gravel pad ~19-30 m from shore behind a thin fringe, group-type 23 ~17 m, both tagged Lakefront, photo 23 shows lake across low grass. Tagged 24 ~35 m through forest and 19 ~100 m behind marsh do not earn it. 37-acre lake; FS: RVs under 35 ft.

name: Dinner Station Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232152 catalog (009-022, no water tags, no photos) on winter satellite: spur at site 013 (max 50 ft) ends ~13-20 m from the Taylor through sparse pine; 9-12 ~40 m. Channel ~14-17 m wide, creek by size. Rec.gov: most sites have the river on one side. No photo and one spur only, so held at riverview. Pin was in open sage ~360 m from located sites.

name: Dearhamer Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234757 Riverfront tags on 001, 002, 003, 005 (max 40-69 ft); satellite 39.3612,-106.7385 with catalog: pads ~33-36 m from the Fryingpan through cottonwoods with open understory; photo 001 shows river across grass. Measured channel ~12-18 m, under 30 m. Ruedi inlet arm ~33-50 m behind a tree belt earns no lake value.

name: Deer Creek Campground (Bailey)
evidence: Canopy-blind satellite + NHD overlay 39.5075,-105.5545: pads in a narrow bottom between Deer and Camp Creeks, ~13 m from the coarse Camp Creek line. Rec.gov 10165255 has no site data. FS: creeks join by the campground; dated Dyrt reports (Jun 2026 '4-5 sites of 12 creek side', 2019 site #5) do not name an RV site. Small stream.

name: Elkhead Reservoir State Park (Bears Ears)
evidence: cpwshop GIS site points on legible satellite 40.5588,-107.3801: rim pads 009, 010, 012, 014, 016 ~13-26 m from the waterline across open unused grass, loop road on the inland side; all tagged Lakefront, 54-64 ft. Site photos 009, 010, 014 show open water past the pad. Non-electric, nightly. Reservoir side of the dam.

name: Elk Creek Campground (Conejos River)
evidence: NHD overlay: the stream beside the sites is Elk Creek, not the Conejos. Rec.gov 273348 Riverfront tags on 01, 11, 13, 14 (max 30-45 ft) on satellite: 13 ~15 m, 01, 11, 14 ~20 m; photo 13 shows table at the water. Channel ~14-20 m wide including braids, under 30 m.

name: Elbert Creek Campground
evidence: Rec.gov 10165280 is a placeholder and no site map or photos found. Satellite frames around 39.1528,-106.4134: north loop ~60 m from Halfmoon Creek in spruce; road spurs east and west of the pin come ~20-35 m through trees, no pad identifiable or tied to the campground. Dyrt review is unclear and aggregator. Defaults down.

name: Elk Wallow Campground
evidence: Satellite 39.3444,-106.6146: loop spur ~32-41 m from a ~6 m creek through shrub and tree row; a bare patch reaches ~11 m but is not identifiable as pads. No rec.gov listing or site photos. Campendium and a Dyrt Oct 2020 review give a 22 ft max vehicle, so a creek site would not count anyway; that review says a split-rail fence separates camp from the river.
